note: Chase Total Checking: $15 a month, waived in a statement period with $500 or more of qualifying electronic deposits, a balance of $1,500 or more at the beginning of each day, or an average beginning-day balance of $5,000 or more (the last counting linked accounts, which the game doesn't hold, so this account's alone).
